scope: One owned synthetic Job with one artificial disappearing-member injection and bounded short-lived children; no official game, model, training cache, or replay read.
acceptance: One injection discarded, at least one retry and complete sample, successful exit, launcher reaped, Job empty, no cleanup error.
retry_policy: One attempt; no rerun after started or result exists.
limits_interpretation: Sampled RSS is not a hard real-time bound; artificial injection does not prove the prior failure cause.
